Discover the heart of Lititz at Dosie Dough, famed for ‘The Best Buns in Town’. Our bakery and cafe is a cozy spot where locals and visitors mingle over our signature organic Dosie Dough coffees, fresh bagels, and an array of homemade baked delights.

Not just a bakery, we also serve up delicious breakfast and lunch sandwiches, soups, and salads. It’s the perfect blend of community, comfort, and culinary treats in America’s coolest small town.

Drop by Dosie Dough for a taste of local charm and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

See our catering Menu

STOP IN THE STORE TODAY TO TRY OUR SPECIALS!

We’re known for ‘The Best Buns in Town’, but our swag is just as irresistible! Step into our cafe and you’ll find more than just your favorite treats; our collection of fun and stylish merchandise awaits you. From comfy t-shirts and cozy hoodies to trendy totes and playful mugs, each item is a reflection of our cafe’s unique charm and the spirit of Lititz.

Our swag is not just about making a fashion statement – it’s about carrying a piece of Dosie Dough’s warmth and joy wherever you go. Whether you’re looking for a special keepsake or a fun gift, our swag collection has something for everyone.

At Dosie Dough, we’re passionate about great food, quality ingredients, and our community. We’re always looking for enthusiastic, dedicated individuals to join our team. If you thrive in a fast-paced, friendly environment and have a passion for customer service, we’d love to hear from you! Apply online below! We look forward to meeting you.

Dosie Dough has been a cherished part of downtown Lititz since November 1996. We are a local family-owned business fueled by a passion for great food, quality ingredients, and community. The journey of Dosie Dough began with Marsha Baron, who started with a stand in the bustling Shillington Farmers Market in 1988. This humble beginning eventually expanded into our current location in the heart of Lititz.

Our Lititz cafe is a warm, homey, and eclectic space. It is a true community-centered café, perfect for meeting new people and discovering what’s happening in town. We offer our signature organic Dosie Dough blend coffees, fresh bagels, European-style breads, and homemade baked goods and donuts daily. Additionally, we serve a variety of made-to-order breakfast and lunch sandwiches all day long.

We are passionate about using the freshest ingredients, sourced locally whenever possible. Our café is not just a place to grab a bite; it’s a place to relax, work, or catch up with friends. With comfortable seating and a welcoming atmosphere, you’ll feel right at home.

Come find out why Lititz is America’s coolest small town!

Dosie Dough has been a cherished part of downtown Lititz since November 1996. We are a local family-owned business fueled by a passion for great food, quality ingredients, and community. The journey of Dosie Dough began with Marsha Baron, who started with a stand in the bustling Shillington Farmers Market in 1988. This humble beginning eventually expanded into our current location in the heart of Lititz.

In 1998, Marsha’s daughter, Amy Lloyd, took over the café, carrying forward the family tradition. Under her leadership, our cozy café has grown and evolved alongside our community. We’ve expanded in size and menu offerings, but we’ve always retained the fun, welcoming, community vibe that we are known for today.

[H1] Location
The Leo Nightly Smoke Shop is located at 100 Test Street, Lititz, Pennsylvania. Free parking is available in the lot behind the building. We are on the corner of Test Street and Sample Avenue.

[H1] Hours
The Leo Nightly Smoke Shop is open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time. We are open Saturday from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We are closed on Sundays. Our opening hours and business hours are the same every week of the year, including holidays.

[H1] What We Sell
The Leo Nightly Smoke Shop sells three products: the Standard Widget, the Deluxe Widget, and the Replacement Gasket. The Standard Widget costs $19.99 and the Deluxe Widget costs $34.99. All widgets come with a one year warranty.

[H1] About Us
The Leo Nightly Smoke Shop is a fixture entity used only to smoke-test the LeoAI production deployment. It is not a real business and has no real customers. It was created by the leo-nightly routine.
